question.text: How many days prior to launching a scheme must the PPM be filed with SEBI by a Category III AIF (non-LVF)?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per SEBI (AIF) Regulations, the PPM along with scheme fee must be filed at least 30 days before the launch of a non-LVF Cat III scheme. **The Trap:** Shorter timelines (15/21 days) are not prescribed; 60 days is not applicable. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same 30-day notice applies to Cat I/II AIFs under XIX-A. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Build a 45-day buffer into launch calendars to accommodate any SEBI observations that require PPM amendments.
